title: ng-icon-forge ng-add options
description: Generates Angular PWA icon assets from a source SVG and merges them into manifest.webmanifest, ngsw-config.json, and index.html.

svg.description: Path to the source SVG file to generate the icon set from.
svg.x-prompt: Path to the source SVG file:

project.description: The name of the project to add icons to. Required when the workspace has more than one project.

maskablePadding.description: Safe-zone padding percentage (applied per side) for the maskable manifest icons.

bg.description: Background color used to flatten the apple-touch-icon (iOS ignores alpha) and to fill the maskable icon canvas.
